files.content:
# Pixel Chess Clock

An offline two-player chess clock. Each side starts with five minutes. Tap a side to start its clock; tap the other side after a move to switch turns. Use Pause to stop the running clock, then tap a side to resume play. When time reaches zero, the clock shows `Flag!` and stops.

## Run

Open `index.html` in a modern browser. The app uses only local HTML, CSS, and JavaScript; it needs no server, packages, or network connection.

## Controls

- Click, tap, or keyboard-activate either clock to start or switch turns.
- Activate Pause to stop the active clock. Tap either side to continue.
- Clock buttons announce each player's remaining time to assistive technology.

## Files

- `index.html` — app structure
- `styles.css` — responsive interface
- `clock.js` — clock behavior
